title: Connecting Al-Insan: the whole surah: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 46 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Connecting Al-Insan rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 46. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: Ayat
Theme
rows: The righteous and their sincere deeds
The Qur'an; patience, dhikr and prayer; Allah's will

arabic.text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا (٢٢) إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا (٢٣)

keywords.def: joining the end of one ayah to the next

questions.q: Chain recitation of Al-Insan, one ayah per pupil.
Rota: today's group recites Al-Insan whole. Everyone else: 3-3-link the joins and log them.
Extend: write the four-part map from memory.
Which part describes the sincere feeding of the poor?
Recite Al-Insan 76:29 in your head. How does the next ayah begin?
Think again: Al-Insan moves from our creation, to the deeds of the righteous, to their reward, to instructions for the Prophet ﷺ. How can that map help your memory?
questions.a: Each part has a clear theme; if you know where you are in the story, the next ayah follows.
